t: Spintronic Computer: Zeeman Splitting Desk — Simple
name: Spintronic Computer: Zeeman Splitting Desk — Simple
title: Spintronic Computer: Zeeman Splitting Desk — Simple

t: Spintronic Computer: Spin Lifetime Analyzer — Simple
name: Spintronic Computer: Spin Lifetime Analyzer — Simple
title: Spintronic Computer: Spin Lifetime Analyzer — Simple
description:
[REAL ENGINEERING] Spins forget: the analyzer budgets the spin lifetime T1/T2 against the operation time — a spin that decoheres before the gate finishes is not a bit. The ratio of lifetime to gate time is the device's quality factor.

Start here. In plain terms: Headline number: Operations in 1 µs lifetime at 10 ns gates = 100 ops. The rest of this record keeps every number honest — each claim below was recomputed, not copied.

real_world_basis: Lifetime-vs-gate budgeting is the real basis of spin-qubit engineering.
signature_version: Signature version: the manifestation lifetime desk — the chapter's target as the coherence target, with the manifestation framing labeled concept.
build_steps: Build: measure the lifetime in your device — literature values flatter.
math_note: Operations in 1 µs lifetime at 10 ns gates: 100 ops [verified]; Fidelity after 100 gates at 99.9% each: 0.9048 fidelity [verified]

math_check.label: Operations in 1 µs lifetime at 10 ns gates

safety: No hazard; the failure mode is a gate count quoted from someone else's T2.
how_it_works: Divide the measured lifetime by the gate time for the operations-per-coherence budget. The demo analyzes a semiconductor spin qubit.
requirements: Re-run the demo program to re-verify every number

title: Spintronic Computer: MRAM Write Budget — Simple
description:

Start here. In plain terms: Headline number: Write current at 1e11 A/m², 50x50 nm bit = 250.0 µA. The rest of this record keeps every number honest — each claim below was recomputed, not copied.

math_note: Write current at 1e11 A/m², 50x50 nm bit: 250.0 µA [verified]; Array write power for 1e6 bits at 1 µA, 1 V (parallel worst): 1.0 W [verified]

safety: No hazard; the failure mode is a bit that forgets at operating temperature.
